name: Talking to a fed-up Boop still gets a face
case: The person pokes Boop until it's fed up (its face; its mood steps once), then a few seconds later says sorry and that it's doing great. It answers with a face, never none and never grumpy: a proud, happy, excited or calm one for the kind words, or, since the apology softens it a step, an irritated or annoyed one.
why: The one mood graph (2026-10-15): a mood moves one step along its pack's moves and holds at least 30 s (MoodPolicy), so a barrage moves the mood once. PERSONALITY: talked to, Boop always answers with a face, never none, proud at kind words, whatever its mood. A fed-up mood from pokes mustn't make it ignore you. characters/boop/steering/mood/grumpy.md: saying sorry moves it to irritated or annoyed, and the guide reacts with the new mood's face
